text: The most visible behaviour changes this week touch billing, connectors and reporting. #12207 marks MCP Data Query Tools as billable and requires a pricing acknowledgement before activation, and headless imports default to disabled. #12242 opens Power BI report deployment to all companies, not only evaluation ones. #12064 lets the SharePoint connector handle hash and percent characters in paths, with a new REST Base Folder Path Format setting. #11560 adds Peppol BIS 3.0 export of self-billed purchase invoices and credit memos, and #11748 adds bonded-location handling to excise tax. #12213 adds row and column definition preview to financial reports. Most other merges are fixes. In manufacturing and inventory: #11959, #12188, #12059, #11994 and #12124. In Shopify: #12260, #12215, #12214 and #12139, plus #11604, which captures the delivered timestamp. Billing and tax fixes: #10182, #11637, #12141, #12127 and #11848. Platform fixes include #12255, #12309, #12304, #12261 and #12118. Cleanup and tooling include #12293 and #12290, which remove CLEAN27 code, and #12307, which makes a default dimension upgrade set-based. #10799 makes SetSwissExport callable from cloud extensions. BCQuality added several knowledge articles, among them #214, #208 and #177.
